categories.core_library: Foundational libraries, configuration frameworks, and required APIs for dependent mods
categories.server_performance: Main tick loop optimization, pathfinding AI caching, collision algorithms, and Redstone BFS engine
categories.memory_optimization: JVM heap optimization, memory footprint reduction for blockstates, models, and dynamic class loading
categories.network_and_players: Netty packet pipeline optimization, player broadcast batching, and high-concurrency entity tracking
categories.worldgen_and_chunks: Parallel chunk I/O, SIMD-accelerated noise generation, structure bounding box optimization, and pre-generation
categories.bugfix_and_security: Backported vanilla bug fixes, NBT packet crash exploit prevention, and packet payload buffer expansion
categories.entity_mechanics: Mob despawn persistence rules and combat AI tuning to prevent unintended mob cap inflation
categories.experimental_threading: Multi-threaded entity ticking (Experimental/Alpha) - High risk, isolated from default runtime
categories.optional_client_side: Client visual mods (LOD) or redundant optimization mods superseded by native server settings

mods.name: Chunky
mods.remediation_advice: Execute /chunky start to pre-generate world chunks before launching server to players.

mods.name: Forge Config API Port
mods.remediation_advice: Forge Config API bridge for Fabric; required dependency for skeletonaifix.

mods.name: Packet Fixer
mods.remediation_advice: Removes 2MB payload buffer limit; prevents player kick/disconnect on oversized NBT/inventory packets.

mods.name: Resourcefulconfig
mods.remediation_advice: Declarative configuration framework; required dependency for structure_layout_optimizer.

mods.name: ScalableLux
mods.remediation_advice: Optimizes vanilla 26.x lighting engine; fully integrated and concurrent with C2ME.

mods.name: Almanac
mods.remediation_advice: Library framework by frikinjay; embeds DungeonConfig; required for letmedespawn.

mods.name: Alternate Current
mods.remediation_advice: Replaces vanilla redstone lag with high-performance BFS algorithm. Lithium automatically yields redstone calculation.

mods.name: Async Logger
mods.remediation_advice: Offloads console and file logging I/O to background thread, preventing log-spam tick hitches.

mods.name: Concurrent Chunk Management Engine
mods.remediation_advice: Concurrent Chunk Management Engine (parallel chunk I/O and terrain gen). Adjust worker threads in config/c2me.toml if high CPU/OOM occurs.

mods.name: CrashExploitFixer
mods.remediation_advice: Hardens server against malicious NBT tag crash exploits (Paper backport).

mods.name: Debugify
mods.remediation_advice: Patches dozens of vanilla bugs; individual fixes configurable via debugify.json.

mods.name: Fabric API
mods.remediation_advice: Core Fabric API layer. Mandatory; verify Fabric Loader compatibility if mixin errors occur.

mods.name: FerriteCore
mods.remediation_advice: Drastically reduces memory footprint for blockstates and models. Highly stable.

mods.name: Krypton
mods.remediation_advice: Optimizes Netty networking pipeline, minimizing CPU overhead during heavy client traffic.

mods.name: LetMeDespawn
mods.remediation_advice: Allows mobs holding dropped items to despawn naturally, preventing cave/dungeon entity accumulation.

mods.name: Lithium
mods.remediation_advice: General server tick optimization (AI, physics, chunk ticking). Modules can be toggled via config/lithium.properties.

mods.name: ModernFix
mods.remediation_advice: Optimizes class loading, dynamic resource leaks, and overall RAM usage.

mods.name: Puzzles Lib
mods.remediation_advice: Foundational abstraction library by Fuzs; required dependency for skeletonaifix.

mods.name: quick-pack
mods.remediation_advice: Accelerates zip file decompression for datapacks and resourcepacks during server boot.

mods.name: ServerCore
mods.remediation_advice: Dynamic view/simulation distance and entity activation range limits during tick spikes.

mods.name: Skeleton AI Fix
mods.remediation_advice: Fixes awkward skeleton strafing behavior to ensure smooth combat AI.

mods.name: Structure Layout Optimizer
mods.remediation_advice: Optimizes structure piece bounding box calculation during terrain generation.

mods.name: Very Many Players
mods.remediation_advice: Very Many Players: entity tracking and packet dispatch optimization for multi-player loads.

mods.name: ZConfig
mods.remediation_advice: Lightweight configuration library; required dependency for zfastnoise.

mods.name: Fast Noise
mods.remediation_advice: Replaces vanilla noise generation with vectorized FastNoise SIMD calculations.

mods.name: Distant Horizons
mods.remediation_advice: Level-of-Detail (LOD) generator. Moved to mods_optional/ due to heavy SQLite I/O and CPU overhead on dedicated servers.

mods.name: Ksyxis
mods.remediation_advice: Skips spawn chunks. Moved to mods_optional/; superseded natively by spawn-chunk-radius=1 in server.properties.

mods.name: Async
mods.remediation_advice: Multi-threaded entity ticking (Alpha). Isolated to mods_optional/ to eliminate ConcurrentModificationException in dungeons/spawners.

mods.name: Clumps
mods.remediation_advice: Aggregates multiple XP orbs into a single clustered orb entity, eliminating XP-induced tick stalls.

mods.name: Carpet Mod
mods.remediation_advice: Technical server mechanics & TNT optimization engine. Configure /carpet optimizedTNT true and /carpet tntDoCollision false to prevent entity collision freezing during mass detonations.

mods.name: Get It Together, Drops!
mods.remediation_advice: Widens gravitational radius and accelerates item merging, preventing thousands of floating block drops from choking entity ticks.
